items.body: 8 ohms on +5VALW is a definite short. Replaced C45 (a 22uF 6.3V ceramic cap near the +5VALW inductor) and the board powered on. Measured 480 ohm to ground after the fix. The fault was a shorted ceramic capacitor.
It might be the EC/KBC holding the rail off. Could be a firmware issue. Try reflashing the BIOS.
